LKH3SamplerSettings.description: Sampling recipe for the long video sampler; connect to the sampler's sampler_settings input to override its widget defaults.

0.name: sampler settings
0.tooltip: Connect to the long video sampler's sampler_settings input.

refine_latent.name: refine latent
refine_latent.tooltip: Second-pass AV latent (chain: this node's av_latent -> LKH3AVUpscale -> here). When connected, the node re-samples the upscaled latent with a truncated schedule (HD second pass) instead of generating fresh latents. The first pass must have run the full segment range.

refine_denoise.name: refine denoise
refine_denoise.tooltip: Starting sigma of the truncated second-pass schedule (= denoise strength). 0.3-0.5 sharpens upscaled latents; 1.0 regenerates fully. Ignored by the first pass.

refine_audio.name: refine audio
refine_audio.tooltip: Second-pass audio policy. keep: hold the first-pass audio bit-exact (locked mask). regenerate: re-denoise the audio stream as well. Ignored by the first pass.

5.name: av_latent
5.tooltip: Packed AV latent of the executed range with lk_layout metadata. Feed through LKH3AVUpscale and back into refine_latent for the HD second pass.

LKH3AVUpscale.description: Spatially upscales the video part of the packed AV latent for the HD second pass; audio and layout metadata pass through unchanged. Chain: long video sampler av_latent -> this node -> long video sampler refine_latent.

av_latent.name: av_latent
av_latent.tooltip: Packed AV latent from the long video sampler's av_latent output.

upscale_method.name: upscale method
upscale_method.tooltip: Interpolation applied to the video latent (and its mask).

scale_by.name: scale by
scale_by.tooltip: Spatial scale factor. The default 2.0 takes the 0.5MP base canvas to the H3 trained maximum (~1920x1088). The second pass costs roughly scale^2 more compute per token than the first pass.

0.name: av_latent
0.tooltip: Upscaled packed AV latent; connect to the long video sampler's refine_latent.
